description: This file defines CLI commands for DNS setup, specifically for configuring CoreDNS for wide-area discovery in a network, including setup procedures, zone file management, and integration with system services.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously with optional error handling based on provided options.

methods.name: writeFileSudoIfNeeded
methods.description: Writes content to a file, using sudo if necessary.

methods.name: mkdirSudoIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates a directory, using sudo if necessary.

methods.name: zoneFileNeedsBootstrap
methods.description: Checks if a DNS zone file needs bootstrap data based on its content.

methods.name: ensureImportLine
methods.description: Ensures an import line exists in the Corefile.

methods.name: registerDnsCli
methods.description: Registers DNS CLI commands for setup and configuration.
